name: grocery
description: Grocery price lookup and basket optimizer (grocery_optimizer). Give a list of grocery items (and optionally which stores to consider: Aldi, Harris Teeter, Trader Joe's, Whole Foods) and get the cheapest single store that covers the whole list, with per-store totals and missing items. Prices are this week's demo catalogue.
quality_note: deterministic; demo catalogue of ~26 items across 4 stores
